behavior_contracts.P4.1/attached-roots: Fetch/judge/LLM declarations carry mandatory attached asserts rows. Rows invoke the declaration through the ordinary call checker, so given inputs and grouped state bind exactly as consumer calls do; questions/arms keep judge-owned coverage and declare no rows.
behavior_contracts.P4.1/using-raw: Attached rows and native lexical when rows accept one using raw mode naming a source-relative can.native-fixture.v1 file confined to the owning project. Check binds target exactly to the invoked declaration identity and admits only environment keys the inherited connection reads; a missing key simulates absence. Raw mode on ordinary function targets rejects.
behavior_contracts.P4.1/coverage: Every fetch/judge/LLM declaration needs at least one raw case with a response outcome comparing its prepared request (request/decoder coverage). Null-exchange rows admit pretransport failures only and never satisfy coverage alone.
